description: TRMNL X private plugins: My Teams, M.League standings, Radio Red tracker
name: trmnl-x-playground

scripts.generate-types: for c in */wrangler.toml; do npx wrangler types "${c%/wrangler.toml}/worker-configuration.d.ts" --config "$c"; done
scripts.check-wrangler: for c in */wrangler.toml; do npx wrangler types --check "${c%/wrangler.toml}/worker-configuration.d.ts" --config "$c"; done
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run format:check && npm run check-wrangler
